title: Agent-Assist Support Knowledge Assistant
opportunity_summary: Agent-assist assistant embedded in Zendesk for 73 support and escalation staff handling 41,000 tickets a year. Retrieval over 2,400 pages of Confluence and public Markdown documentation, 340 SharePoint runbooks and 96,000 closed tickets; grounded reply drafting with sources shown, ticket classification and routing, and similar-ticket retrieval. Every outbound reply is human-approved. No cloud preference stated, so a platform recommendation with reasoning is required. PII redaction, EU data residency, no third-party training on customer data, 24-month audit retention, and a documented evaluation approach are mandatory.
requested_by: Dana Okonkwo, VP Customer Support, Arbormill Software
regulatory_constraints: EU data residency clauses in three enterprise contracts

demo_change.description: After the data protection officer's review of provider retention terms, the AI provider preference changes from the recommended platform's managed model service to open-weight models hosted in the customer's own EU region, so that inference and prompt retention stay inside the EU.
